resources.string: This habit belongs to your campaign. The System sets it; you can archive it, not edit it.
Forty-five days. Three acts. One version of you on the other side.
Answer ten questions and the System builds a campaign around your weakest stat: a few daily habits that start easy and get harder as you do.
Clear 32 of the 45 days to finish it. Missed days never reset anything.
Days 1–15 · easy, to build the habit
How often do you move your body on purpose: a walk, a workout, a sport?
How often do you do anything that makes you stronger: push-ups, lifting, climbing stairs?
How often do you read or learn something that isn\'t required of you?
How often can you work on one thing for 25 minutes without switching?
When you plan to do something, how often do you actually do it?
How often do you put your phone down when you meant to?
How often do you sleep seven hours or more?
How often do you eat real meals and drink enough water?
How often do you reach out to a friend or family member first?
How often do you say what you think, even when it\'s uncomfortable?
Your body is the foundation everything else stands on. The campaign rebuilds it first.
Your mind wants more than it\'s getting. The campaign gives it daily reps.
You know what to do; doing it is the gap. The campaign trains follow-through.
You\'re running on empty. The campaign starts with sleep, food and recovery.
The people around you are a strength you\'re not using. The campaign builds it back.
These habits join your Today list. Each act raises their difficulty; the System sets the targets.
A campaign needs at least 3 free habit slots. Archive a habit and try again.
The System couldn\'t find habits that fit your equipment and injury settings.
